title: BendyHills: Sunny Room for Business or Fun Travel!
description:
Guest room in an exceptional home with artistic decor and peaceful well- maintained grounds. Location is ideal for business or sightseeing. Kitchen and living room shared w/ owners, bath occasionally shared w/ another at times.  In-room: Mini Fridge w/filtered water pitcher and dishes. TV w/ Roku unit and guest account. Hosts live on the property and the bedrooms are all in one hall.  Parking on the top of our driveway as well as street parking is available.

The space
HIlltop wooded neighborhood just within Nashville city limits, 1.3 miles from I-40, just 20 minutes from the state capital and Broadway, 18  minutes from Maryland Farms business park. and 20 minutes from Cool Springs.

Guest access
Kitchen
Living Room
Deck and Backyard
Printer

During your stay
Privacy is respected.  Up to 2 Airbnb single rooms may be rented at one time.

Other things to note
We have 3 cats, the cat sisters who are awfully friendly but won't get their feelings hurt if you don't want to scratch their heads!
